comment: Receipts recorded on Arc mainnet by the reference service. Listed by transaction hash rather than discovered by scanning: the public RPC rejects eth_getLogs over more than ~5,000 blocks, and at 0.5s per block the gap from the registry's deployment grows by ~172,800 blocks a day. Appended by scripts/record-receipt.mjs.
apiComment: Base URL of the live service. null hides the interactive demo. Append ?api=http://localhost:3000 to the page URL to drive it against a local service. Free hosting sleeps when idle, so the first request after a quiet spell takes about a minute.

receipts.note: The sample globe in this repo: 1.97 MB in, 0.27 MB out. 9,216 triangles and 4,753 vertices both ways.
A genuinely paid call, $0.02 in USDC. The file it covers is an earlier fixture, no longer in the repo.
